## Analysis overview

Creates completer and safety analysis groups, calculates treatment-specific subject counts, and summarizes average daily dose and cumulative dose.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `COMP24FL`: Week 24 completion flag
- `SAFFL`: safety population flag
- `AVGDD`: average daily dose
- `CUMDOSE`: cumulative dose
- `TRT01P/TRT01PN`: planned treatment
- `USUBJID`: subject identifier.
